metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}?action=Pause (an invalid value for the required action enum). Wire-vs-canonical-docs disagreement: canonical/swagger describe a 400 with errorCode 5222 ('Invalid device update action. Allowed values are "START" and "STOP".'). The actual wire response is HTTP 422 (not 400) with errorCode 1012 — the API's generic model-validation error shape, same family as the bulk-rank endpoint's 422 responses — and a different message text ('Invalid device update action. Allowed values are Start, Stop.', mixed-case, embedded in a RequestQuery.QueryParams validation wrapper) than the 5222 text documented for this operation. errorCode 5222 was never observed on the wire for this call. Re-confirmed identical on 26.4.0.0: same 422/1012, same message text, regardless of whether a deployment exists under the update+org group (the query-param validation fires before any deployment lookup).
